The '''Fairy Rose''' is a [[Flowers|flower]] that can be [[Crops|grown]] from [[Fairy Seeds]] in 12 days. 

If grown within proper range of a [[Bee House#Range|Bee House]] (5 squares in any cardinal direction), a Fairy Rose will cause [[Honey|Fairy Rose Honey]] to be produced, increasing the honey base value from {{Price|100}} to {{Price|680}}. This is the most valuable type of honey, compensating for the poor profit margins on the flower itself.

Fairy Roses can be purchased from the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|290}}.

==Bundles==
Fairy Rose is one of the options for the {{Bundle|garden||y}}.

==Tailoring==
Fairy Rose can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[File:Long Dress.png|36px]] [[Tailoring#Pants|Long Dress]]. The fairy rose can also be used as a red dye pot color for [[dyeing]], located in [[2 Willow Lane]], [[Emily]] and [[Haley]]'s house.

==Quests==
Fairy Rose is not used in any [[quests]].

==Notes==
*Fairy Roses have an equal chance of being one of six different colors. Fairy Roses of different colors will occupy different slots in inventory or chests. Six colors × four [[Crops#Crop Quality|quality]] levels = 24 possible spaces used.
:[[File:FairyRoseColors.png]]
*Despite not having a true red variation, Fairy Roses are used as a red dye in the dye pots.

==Bugs==
*While it was intended for Fairy Roses to increase the chance for the [[Random Events#The Crop Fairy|Crop Fairy event]], with code appearing to check for having at least one mature Fairy Roses on the farm by the end of a day to increase the chance by 70% (from 1% to 1.7%), this does not actually happen in game as that check is not valid.<ref name="cropfairychanceincrease" />
